events.title: AlgoHunt
events.description: A physical-digital contest where algorithms unlock checkpoints, clues, and leaderboard momentum across campus.

timeline.title: AlgoHunt v4.0: The Campus Node
timeline.description: The biggest campus-wide algorithmic treasure hunt returns. We are completely overhauling the puzzle engine to integrate deep cryptography, physical lock-picking, and GPS-fenced checkpoints across the university architecture.
features: Dynamic scoring based on physical sprint time

timeline.title: AlgoHunt v3.0: The WebSocket Era
timeline.description: Our first massive-scale deployment. We introduced a live-updating dashboard that tracked teams physically moving across campus in real time. The pressure of watching rival teams jump ahead on the leaderboard while running up the stairs changed the game.

timeline.title: AlgoHunt v2.0: Reverse Engineering
timeline.description: Expanded the core algorithmic formula to include reverse-engineering nodes. Teams had to decompile binaries on their laptops while standing in the cafeteria to unlock the next physical location.

timeline.title: AlgoHunt Genesis
timeline.description: The inaugural event that started it all. We wanted to see if we could blend competitive programming with a physical race. It was chaotic, the servers crashed for 5 minutes, but the energy was unparalleled.

winners.name: Team Enigma
winners.quote: The combination of algorithmic thinking and sprinting across campus was unparalleled!

winners.name: Runtime Terrors
winners.quote: We spent 20 minutes debugging Dijkstra while physically standing in the rain. Best event ever.

winners.name: O(1) Braincells
winners.quote: The final checkpoint puzzle blew our minds. Incredible execution by the CodeChef team.

events.detailedExplanation: AlgoHunt transforms competitive programming into a high-octane physical reality. It demands a unique hybrid of rapid code execution, team communication under pressure, and physical stamina. AlgoHunt tests not just how well you know Dijkstra's algorithm, but how fast your team can debug it while racing against the clock to the next checkpoint.

systems.title: AlgoHunt Base
systems.description: The dedicated technical platform built to power our competitive coding hackathons. At its core, AlgoHunt Base utilizes the Piston engine to provide a secure, isolated sandbox for code execution across multiple programming languages. It acts as the backbone for algorithmic events, offering a reliable, high-performance environment for compiling submissions and evaluating solver logic in real-time.

systems.title: Eclipse
systems.description: Our end-to-end hackathon event management platform. Eclipse acts as the central nervous system during our flagship events, handling everything from initial team registrations to live crowd control on the day of the event. It streamlines the entire participant lifecycle, abstracting away logistical friction so we can manage hundreds of hackers seamlessly from a unified dashboard.
